options: Submodule: exact pin, never edited here, history kept separate
Subtree: the icons must be editable locally
Either; there is no difference for icons
Subtree: files in a plain clone, local patches, fixes pushed back with subtree push
Submodule: the helper library must be pinned exactly
Neither; copy the files by hand and never update them
Subtree: the files must be present in every plain clone and nobody edits them, so there is no pointer to maintain
Submodule: fonts rarely change, so a pin is best
Submodule: binary files cannot go in a subtree

goals.label: icons is a submodule (gitlink at icons)

check.script: git ls-tree HEAD icons | grep -q '^160000 ' && grep -q 'path = icons' .gitmodules

goals.label: utils is a subtree (regular files under vendor/utils)

check.script: git ls-tree -r HEAD vendor/utils | grep -q '^100644 blob .*version.txt' && ! git ls-tree HEAD vendor/utils | grep -q '^160000 ' && git log --format=%B HEAD | grep -q '^git-subtree-dir: vendor/utils$'

goals.label: fonts is a subtree (regular files under vendor/fonts)

check.script: git ls-tree -r HEAD vendor/fonts | grep -q '^100644 blob .*version.txt' && ! git ls-tree HEAD vendor/fonts | grep -q '^160000 ' && git log --format=%B HEAD | grep -q '^git-subtree-dir: vendor/fonts$'
